seed_policy: One newly generated pair, replayed unchanged on pristine, each isolated mutant, and every restoration.
environment: CHOUSA_* removed; GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE removed; LC_ALL=C.utf8; TMPDIR and C2_TMP point into isolated scratch; subprocess process groups killed on completion/timeout.

commands.exact_expanded_commands_and_outputs: Each STAGE.json records exact commands, exit codes, stdout/stderr artifact paths, before/after hashes. Counter receipts carry frozen-counter and gate hashes.

expected_detector: C2 contract 1 requires observed=invalid for every present non-string, whitespace-padded, prefixed, non-64-length, or empty pin. Frozen counter kill is matched<120 on a passing pristine baseline; built-in selftest kill is a new FAIL-case on a passing pristine baseline; focused detector compares explicit CLAIM verdicts and stale-only revision findings.

baseline.focused_note: Exit 1 is expected for a mixed fixture containing invalid and stale claims; the detector uses claim-level verdicts, not that exit alone.

mutants.name: Treat a non-string sha256 as absent
mutants.edit: Line 1444: replace if json_has_key "$line" sha256; then with if json_str "$line" sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
mutants.focused_killing_cases: null, true, false, number 17, empty array, empty object: invalid -> supported

mutants.name: Trim leading and trailing whitespace
mutants.edit: After line 1448 add: while [[ $sha_pin == [[:space:]]* ]]; do sha_pin=${sha_pin#?}; done; while [[ $sha_pin == *[[:space:]] ]]; do sha_pin=${sha_pin%?}; done
mutants.focused_killing_cases: A correct 64-character digest with leading, trailing, or both spaces: invalid -> supported
mutants.coverage_explanation: Existing selftest I6 is a space followed by 63 a characters. Trimming still leaves an invalid 63-character digest, so that fixture does not kill trim normalization.

mutants.name: Strip sha256: prefix
mutants.selftest_killing_case: claims-sha-invalid I4: invalid -> stale; invalid=6 rather than 7
mutants.focused_killing_cases: sha256: plus correct digest: invalid -> supported

mutants.name: Accept 63-65 lowercase hex characters
mutants.edit: Line 1460: replace ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ with ^[0-9a-f]{63,65}$ in sha_pin validation only
mutants.selftest_killing_case: claims-sha-invalid I2/I3: invalid -> stale; invalid=5 rather than 7
mutants.focused_killing_cases: 63- and 65-character lowercase hex pins: invalid -> stale, with revision mismatch findings

mutants.name: Ignore an empty string sha256 pin
mutants.selftest_killing_case: claims-sha-invalid I7: invalid -> supported; invalid=6 rather than 7; VERDICT_BEARING_CLAIMS=1/7

restoration.method: Reverse each surgical edit before applying the next. Every restored-stage runner asserts byte-for-byte equality to pristine-gate.sh before running the identical three detectors.
restoration.final_cmp_command: timeout 30 bash -c 'ulimit -v 2097152; ulimit -u 16384; cmp /fast/scratch/hyaku/chousa-r31/w2/MutC2Parse/pristine-gate.sh /fast/scratch/hyaku/chousa-r31/w2/MutC2Parse/repo/tools/research-gate.sh && printf "RESTORED_CMP_EXIT=0\n" && sha256sum /fast/scratch/hyaku/chousa-r31/w2/MutC2Parse/pristine-gate.sh /fast/scratch/hyaku/chousa-r31/w2/MutC2Parse/repo/tools/research-gate.sh /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/chousa-shokunin/tools/research-gate.sh /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/chousa-shokunin/corpus/evidence/round31/c2-count.py'

limits_and_disclosures: Initial setup used ulimit -u 256, causing bash fork Resource temporarily unavailable and exit 254 before cloning. Retried with the documented 16384 cap; clone and checkout then exited 0.

Initial pristine suite forced LC_ALL=C. Counters were 120/120 twice; selftest failed 10/228 (exit 1), first failure P4 arrow claim observed=unsupported; focused 16/16. This is an inconclusive baseline, not a killed mutant. Raw pristine.* artifacts are retained.

locale -a (timeout 20) exited 0 and listed C, C.utf8, en_US.utf8, POSIX. Harness environment was corrected to installed C.utf8 before any mutation. The pristine-utf8 suite passed and that identical environment was used for all mutant/restored suites.
Counter definitions and predicates were never edited or re-scaled. Focused cases are supplemental evidence, not frozen-counter matches.
No production writes, no lane/fleet git or jj writes, no network, no subagents, no background jobs, no tool installations or updates.

These findings challenge detector coverage, not the tested pristine implementation: pristine rejected all 13 malformed focused pins; all three supported/absent/stale controls also matched. No integration or admission judgment made.
